claims.text: Node drain started for a kernel upgrade on 2025-10-21 02:10.
Cache pod evicted and orders-api logged connection refused errors for cache:6379 on 2025-10-21 02:11.
Cache pod was found stuck in Pending, its volume bound to the drained node on 2025-10-21 02:29.
Node was back in the cluster and the cache statefulset was restarted on 2025-10-21 02:33.
Latency was back to normal and the incident was closed on 2025-10-21 02:36.
The cache pod was evicted during a node drain and did not come back on its own.
orders-api fell back to the database for every read, and checkout p95 latency rose to 2.8 seconds for 22 minutes.
Incident start time was 2025-10-21 02:14 UTC with an incident duration of 22 minutes.
The cache ran as a single pod with no PodDisruptionBudget, so a planned drain took it down.
Its volume was bound to one node, so the pod could not move to another node.
Checkout p95 latency rose from 250 ms to 2.8 s.
orders-api logged "redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Error 111 connecting to cache:6379. Connection refused."
